subject: note: As Freud writes elsewhere, hate is older…

note: Are suicidal patterns of behaviour best explained organically in terms of neurobiology and, even, serotonin levels? Is suicidality even an inheritable condition within, say, certain families and communities?

note: Any full understanding of suicide requires, at the very least, the cultivation of a much longer and broader view of suicidal behaviour across as wide a historical and cultural sweep as possible, along with the richest possible sociological data.
